title: The Basilisk’s Internal Critique of Outfinitism
description: Enter a disabled superintelligence with three disputing examiners and discover why an argument about limits becomes a dramatic question of power.

readerInvitation.reasonToExist: The Basilisk's Internal Critique of Outfinitism turns a philosophy of limits into speculative fiction.
readerInvitation.readerPromise: Enter a disabled superintelligence with three disputing examiners and discover why an argument about limits becomes a dramatic question of power.
readerOutcomes: The investigation begins inside a memory that can reproduce human lives with disturbing precision.

Read it for an investigation whose unsettling object is also an argument about how to investigate.
